name: host
description: Talks to the program that runs the game: a game can ask to stop (a Quit button of a menu) or leave a named command for its host (a launcher plays another game or exports one). The game only says what it wants; what a command does belongs to the host.

components.name: Quit
components.description: When the action named by action is pressed, the game asks its host to stop: the player of the game closes it, a launcher goes back to its list. A Quit button of a menu is an entity with this and a ui.Button that raises the action. On a mobile host, where closing an app is the system's job, it does nothing unless on_mobile is true.

components.name: Call
components.description: When the action named by action is pressed, leaves one request for the host: command (a name of the game's host_command list, such as play or export) and a number that goes with it: argument, or, when list names a list filled while the game runs (a launcher's list of games), the item that is selected in it, so "play" learns which game. Nothing is sent while that list has no selection. What a command does belongs to the host. A command or an action left at none does nothing.

systems.name: trigger
systems.description: Each tick, a pressed action of a Quit asks the host to stop (QuitRequest), and a pressed action of a Call leaves its request in HostRequests; the host reads them between frames.
